method: Figures 1–19 are embedded raster JPEGs at ~300 dpi; full figures and panels were cut from the native rasters (no resampling), white margins trimmed to ~10 px. Tables, the span definition and four text-evidence blocks were rendered from the vector PDF at 300 dpi. The paper has no numbered equations. tools/litdb/extract_figures.py was not used (it writes the shared _sources.json).
note: 2026-11-26 litdb-curator: every crop was opened with Read after cutting; clipped or intruded crops (fig_3_collision, fig_5_section_y, fig_7_side_jar, fig_7_grid_side, fig_7_top_grid, fig_14_full_range, fig_1_experiment_row, fig_4_workflow_boxes, two text crops) were re-cut and re-checked. Neighbour fragments were blanked white only outside the panel content.
